newsitem.title: USA: U.S. swap spreads steady in light activity.
newsitem.headline: U.S. swap spreads steady in light activity.

text.p: Spreads on U.S. interest rate swaps were mostly steady to slightly tighter on Monday in light activity, dealers said.
The biggest move over the past week came in the two-year sector, where a bump in swap spreads caused by a repo special last week has faded.
Spreads on two-year LIBOR swaps were quoted at 17 to 18 basis points bid, 21 basis points offered, about two basis points tighter than a week ago on the bid-side.
Intermediate spreads were also slightly tighter, traders said. A few intermediate dollar-denominated Eurobond issues expected to be swapped were priced last week.
On three-year swaps, spreads were quoted at 18 to 19 basis points bid, 21 to 22 basis points offered, about one basis point tighter than a week ago.
At the long end, swaps remained at historically tight levels. On 10-year swaps, spreads were quoted at 34 basis points bid, 37 basis points offered, unchanged from a week ago.
